documents.Title: Local document search
documents.Body: Search private files on the machine that owns them without uploading their contents.

documents.Title: Distributed query routing
documents.Body: A coordinator sends each search request to local nodes and combines their responses.

documents.Title: Centralized cloud search
documents.Body: Documents are copied to a remote service before they can be indexed and searched.

documents.Title: Document access control
documents.Body: Authorization rules determine which private documents a user may read.

documents.Title: Garden notes
documents.Body: Tomatoes need sunlight, water, and well drained soil.
